sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of 'HuggyBros Christmas' are simple yet engaging. Players control the Huggy brothers as they navigate through a festive landscape, collecting points and purchasing costumes to enhance their gameplay. The game features a variety of obstacles, including sharp thorns and spinning wheels, which must be avoided in order to progress.

The gameplay is straightforward, with players using the WASD keys or arrow keys to move the Huggy brothers, and the mouse or touch controls to jump. The double jump feature is also available, allowing players to navigate through the landscape with ease. The game's physics engine is also responsive, making it feel smooth and natural to play.

One of the standout features of the game's mechanics is the way in which players must collect a key in order to progress. This adds an extra layer of challenge to the game, as players must carefully navigate through the landscape to avoid obstacles and collect the key before reaching the door.

The game also features a variety of costumes that players can purchase to enhance their gameplay.
